page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre ("IMPERIALES"), page number top right. Main text in one full-width block with headings and verse stanzas. A marginal reference "Luc. 23." sits in the right margin beside one line, and a catchword "Crucis" appears at the lower right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~40 letters] Crucem vero Christus tertia die resurrexit, neque sanctam ex mortuis resurrexit. [illegible, ~30 letters]
main_text.head: Et post pauca in eodem Homilia:

p.i: Vide et aliam partem reputans, crucem suam non relinquit intueri, sed potius quam ultra mortuus se credat, sed ait, hoc [illegible, ~20 letters] ideo fecit ut crucem nomen sui servaret.

main_text.head: Item post pauca in eadem Homilia.

p.i: Et cum hominem videbitur ad suum in caelo. Videbit eum in cruce, Matth. Marc. Luc. 23. [illegible, ~60 letters] quod ibi sunt tenebrae et ruptum est velum templi, et Crux lapides scissi sunt, et monumenta aperta sunt, et multa corpora sanctorum surrexerunt, Crux tunc vero, quod omnes, et Filius, et Spiritus Sanctus, in eo Trinitas, amen.

main_text.head: Item Joan. Chrysostomus in Homilia 13. de Cruce Dominica.
main_text.p: Ideo ergo adorate sanctissimam virtutem Crucis, et gaudete ad ejus laudem dicere: Crux ... Crux ... Crux ... (remainder of litany of epithets, largely illegible in the scan).
main_text.head: Item Augustinus in lib. 22. de Civit. Dei:

p.i: Ut Christus Iesus hanc crucis figuram ... de primaria ipsa civitate, in mundo ... Hac illa a perito medico accepit, et ad solam Iesum ... Pascha, et in parte ... crucifixus ... (partly illegible).

main_text.head: Sedulius in 4 lib. Paschalis carminis:
main_text.l: Pax Crucis ... violenta que robora mentis
Supplicium, quod dedit signum magnae salutis,
Ipsaque sanctus in se terminata beavit.
Neve ... Crucem ... spectare ... tuta ... ibi clam,
Ardens dextra tenet, medium laeva fulgerat axem
Cumque ... de membris vivit natura ... ntis,
Et ... Crucem ... amplexum Christus regit undique mundum.
main_text.head: Item Paulinus in lib. 8. Natalis Felicis:
Item idem in libro 10.

page.notes: Scan is heavily damaged, with stains and show-through from the reverse. Greek and Latin passages in the upper and middle text are largely illegible; the verse and litany lines are reconstructed only where letters are visible. Marginal reference "Luc. 23." at right beside the Chrysostom quotation. Page number 162 is read from the top right and may be uncertain.
